public_payload.normalized_proposition: Powerful AI will eventually end up in the hands of bad actors.

statement.excerpt: Powerful AI, sooner or later, will wind up in bad hands.

from_speaker: will wind up in bad hands
our_interpretation: Powerful AI means advanced general-purpose systems capable of substantial coding, reasoning, or operational assistance; it does not require superintelligence.
Bad hands means actors engaged in documented criminal or abusive conduct, rather than actors classified as bad solely by nationality or affiliation.
Usable access to a hosted system counts as having AI in one's hands; ownership of model weights is unnecessary.
A documented instance after publication can settle this existential forecast.
criteria.support_condition: A documented post-publication case establishes that malicious actors obtained usable access to powerful AI and used it in criminal or abusive activity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A finite period without documented misuse cannot contradict this forecast, which has no deadline.
